newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: U.S. monetary policy tightening an issue for APEC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. monetary policy tightening an issue for APEC.

text.p: The recent tightening of monetary policy in the United States could have an impact on the Asia Pacific region and finance ministers of the region should discuss it, the International Monetary Fund recommended.
Finance ministers of the 18 member economies of the Asia Pacific Economic (APEC) forum are due to gather in Cebu in the central Philippines for a two-day meeting beginning Saturday.

An IMF paper to be presented at the meeting, a copy of which was acquired by Reuters on Thursday, cautioned APEC ministers, saying the "continued balanced growth with low inflation in the United States is important for the health of the APEC region."

"How do ministers view the recent tightening of monetary policy in the United States, and prospects for and potential consequences of further tightening, should that appear warranted to contain inflationary risks ?"
"Is there a risk of a major stock market correction in the United States that would have significant repurcussions in other APEC countries ?" the IMF paper said.
